title: The mistake I didn't realise I was making when designing workshops
partialText: The hidden reason good products, meetings and workshops still fail: they depend on a single way of seeing, thinking and processing.

title: The Bike Shed Ep 502:  Apps That Make Our Work Go
partialText: Aji and Sally are back together again, this time to discuss the different apps they use to make their workflows and To Do lists easier and quicker to achieve.

title: AI crawlers are inflating your view counts
partialText: AI crawlers now make up most of your site's traffic, and server-side analytics counts every one of them. Your view counts measure scrapers, not readers. Here is how to fix it.

title: Toast: the 2-minute test that reveals how you think about building products
partialText: Give a team one prompt. Watch them completely diverge. The differences reveal something most product teams never talk about.
